name: Warm Chocolate Rice Pudding with Raspberry Compote & Pistachios

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add milk, sugar, cocoa powder, vanilla, and salt; set over medium heat and bring to a simmer, stirring frequently.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
710 ml whole milk
½ cup brown sugar
⅓ cup cocoa powder
1 tbsp vanilla extract
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a simmer, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice, undisturbed, until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry raspberries; place in another medium saucepan.

Wash, dry, zest, and juice lemons into the saucepan with the raspberries; add sugar and water. Stir to combine and cook over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally, until raspberries are soft and juicy, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
¼ cup brown sugar
89 ml (⅜ cup) water

instructions.primary_message: Once the raspberries are soft, crush with a fork or potato masher; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until compote thickens, 4-5 minutes more. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
Once the rice is done, remove from heat. Add cream, gently stir to combine, and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
To serve, divide rice pudding between bowls; top with raspberry compote and pistachios. Enjoy!
